eda_ts.title: Exploratory data analysis – Time series
eda_ts.intro: This section examines the shape of the series, its trend, variability and distribution characteristics.
eda_ts.need_zoo: The 'zoo' package is missing. Install it: install.packages('zoo')
eda_ts.need_roll_points: The series has too few real (non-NA) values for a moving average.
eda_ts.roll_adjusted: The window was adjusted automatically to k={k} (the series has {n} non-NA values).
eda_rel.title: Exploratory data analysis – Relationships
eda_rel.intro: This section analyses the relationships between the main variables, using charts and the correlation matrix.
eda_rel.need_x_variation: Variable X does not vary enough for a regression.
eda_rel.need_cols: At least 2 numeric columns are needed for the correlation.
eda_rel.need_cols_sd: After the filter (sd > 0) fewer than 2 numeric columns remain.
eda_rel.corr_truncated: Only the first 20 numeric columns were used for the heatmap.
eda_rel.cap_corr: Pearson correlation matrix of the numeric variables.
stat.title: Stationarity and transformations
stat.intro: This section assesses the stationarity of the time series and shows the transformations needed for modelling (e.g. differencing).
stat.need_diff_points: The series has too few real (non-NA) values for a first difference.
stat.need_acf_points: At least ~6 real values are needed for ACF/PACF (differencing loses 1).
stat.need_acf_diff: The differenced series has too few points for ACF/PACF.
stat.acf_constant_diff: ACF/PACF cannot be computed: the differenced series is constant.
stat.cap_acf: ACF/PACF of the first difference of {label}.
stat.adf_note_intro: Interpretation (ADF): For the series {label}{unit}, the null hypothesis of the ADF test is that the series has a unit root (i.e. it is non-stationary). At the significance level α = {alpha}:
stat.adf_level_reject: the null hypothesis is rejected and the series in levels is considered stationary
stat.adf_level_keep: the null hypothesis is not rejected and the series in levels suggests non-stationarity
stat.adf_level_na: the test for the series in levels could not be computed (error during execution)
stat.adf_diff_reject: after the first difference the null hypothesis is rejected and the differenced series is considered stationary
stat.adf_diff_keep: even after the first difference the null hypothesis is not rejected
stat.adf_diff_na: the test for the differenced series could not be computed (error during execution)
ts.incomplete: The series has missing periods, irregular dates or empty values. The EDA plots can be shown, but the statistical analyses and the forecast require a regular time series without gaps.
ts.short: The series has too few valid observations for this analysis.
ts.freq: The frequency of the time series could not be identified. Choose a regular time column or check the data.
ts.index: The time column contains numbers that are not years (e.g. 1, 2, 3…), so the frequency of the series is unknown. The statistical analyses need time in one of the formats: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYQ#. EDA works anyway.
